subject: Bottom of the Well
text: The Bottom of the Well contains only 3 Gold Skulltulas.

evidence.quote:
fortunately there are only 3  
Gold Skullitas here and none of them are hard to find.

subject: Zora's River Frogs
text: Playing the Song of Time and Song of Storms for the frogs at Zora's River rewards a Piece of Heart [PoH33].

evidence.quote:
Head to Zora's River back to the frogs you played music for.  Play the Song 
of Time and after playing the Song of Storms they'll give you [PoH33].

subject: Zora's River Frogs
text: Winning the ocarina fly-eating game with the frogs at Zora's River rewards a Piece of Heart [PoH34].

evidence.quote:
Now 
talk to them again and they'll ask you to play an ocarina game where they  
eat the flies above their head, after winning you'll receive [PoH34].

subject: Gerudo Training Ground
text: The Gerudo Training Ground contains 8 locked doors and 8 keys, and the Ice Arrows cannot be missed.

evidence.quote:
!!!!!First and foremost it is NOT possible to miss the ice arrows there 
!!!!!are 8 locked doors and 8 keys.

subject: Right Door Room
text: Defeating two Lizalfos and a Beamos in the timed room through the right door yields a key.

evidence.quote:
Go to the right door first, there'll be two lizfos and a beamos in the room 
and you'll be timed to beat the three of them...After beating them you'll get a key (that's one).

subject: Lava Pit Room
text: Playing the Song of Time creates two blue blocks to reach a switch that clears the circle of fire, allowing Link to collect a key from the lowest pillar.

evidence.quote:
play the song of time making two blue blocks appear.  Now go to your left  
to the switch and step on it (it makes that circle of fire go away)...Climb up and collect the key  
(that's two).

subject: Water Room
text: Playing the Song of Time opens an underwater hole where collecting silver rupees using the Iron Boots grants a third key.

evidence.quote:
Play the Song of time opening the hole and  
jump into the water.  Use the iron boots to sink to the bottom and start  
collecting the rupees...After collecting the  
rupees you'll get another key (that's three).

subject: Megaton Hammer Room
text: Hitting wall pillars with the Megaton Hammer exposes an eye switch that drops a chest containing the fourth key.

evidence.quote:
Inside you'll find a chest surrounded  
by fire along with some fire bats and lava slug enemies.  Kill the enemies  
and start hitting the pillars against the wall with the megaton hammer...another will expose an eye  
you can shoot on the wall to make another treasure chest drop (the one with 
your fourth key in it).

subject: Statue Room
text: Riding the rotating circular platform and shooting the statue's eyes unlocks a door on the catwalk above and drops a chest containing a key.

evidence.quote:
stand on the round platform and it starts  
moving around the room.  Aim at the center and shoot the eyes as they come  
in range and a treasure chest will drop and a door will unlock...Get the key from the chest (that's five)

subject: Left Door Room
text: Defeating 2 Stalfos within 1 minute in the sand and rock room through the left door yields a key from a chest.

evidence.quote:
Go back to the first room and go onto the left  
door (opposite the side you went through the first time).  you'll be in a  
room with sand and rocks and you'll have 1 minute to kill 2 stalfos and get 
the key from the chest they drop

subject: Wallmaster
text: A Wallmaster will drop onto Link if he stands still too long in the middle section of the timed silver rupee room.

evidence.quote:
After killing them you'll be in a room where you'll immediately see a  
timer.  As expected you'll be collecting silver rupees.  the only thing to  
keep in mind is that the middle section has a wall master that will fall on 
you if stand still too long.

subject: Wolfos Room
text: Defeating four Wolfos and using the Lens of Truth reveals a hidden target above a fake door, leading to the catwalk above the statue room to collect a key from a chest.

evidence.quote:
As you walk in you'll be attacked by four  
wolfos.  After killing them use the lens of truth and you'll see a hole in  
the wall above the fake door...run in and collect the key 
from the chest (that's six).

subject: Like Like Room
text: Defeating three Like Likes behind the silver gauntlet block and using the Lens of Truth reveals a chest in the back right hole with a key.

evidence.quote:
push the silver gauntlet block (if you have the silver gauntlets) enter the 
room and you'll see three likelikes in three holes...Once 
they've been killed use the lens of truth and you'll see a treasure chest 
in each hole.  The back right hole has a key in side (that's seven).

subject: Central Maze
text: Climbing the fence wall inside the left locked door reveals a hidden key, and proceeding through the maze leads to the Ice Arrows at the center.

evidence.quote:
Unlock the door to your left and  
once you enter go to your immediate left and climb the fence wall into a  
hidden room with another key (that's either six or eight).  Continue  
through the maze in the direction you were heading and you'll get to the  
center where you'll get the ice arrows.

subject: Haunted Wasteland Oasis
text: Climbing to the bottom of the center oasis in the Haunted Wasteland reveals Gold Skulltula [GS085] on the wall.

evidence.quote:
When you get to the center oasis climb to the  
bottom and on the wall you'll see [GS085].

subject: Haunted Wasteland Ghost
text: Using the Lens of Truth allows Link to follow the guide ghost across the Haunted Wasteland to Desert Colossus.

evidence.quote:
Climb back out and use the lens 
of truth to follow the ghost to Desert Colossus.

subject: Desert Colossus Fairy Fountain
text: Bombing the cracked wall next to two trees at Desert Colossus grants Nayru's Love inside.

evidence.quote:
When you enter you'll see 
two trees next to a cracked wall to your front right, run over there (while 
avoiding the leavers) and bomb the wall, inside you'll get Naru's Love.

subject: Spirit Temple Warp Song
text: Entering the Spirit Temple and walking back outside teaches Link the song to warp there.

evidence.quote:
Now head to the giant statue in the wall and enter the temple.  Once inside 
walk back out and you'll learn the song to warp there.

subject: Death Mountain Crater Warp Point
text: Using a bug on the soft soil mound next to the Bolero of Fire warp point reveals Gold Skulltula [GS086].

evidence.quote:
Now play the Bolero of  
fire and you'll see next to the warp point a mound of soil, use and  
rebottle a bug to collect [GS086], now plant the bean and warp to Desert  
Colossus.

subject: Spirit Temple Entrance Soil
text: Using a bug on the soft soil mound to the left of the Spirit Temple entrance reveals Gold Skulltula [GS087].

evidence.quote:
To the left of the Spirit temple entrance you'll find the last  
mound of soil.  Use your bug to collect [GS087] and plan your last bean.

subject: Spirit Temple
text: There are five Gold Skulltulas in the Spirit Temple, three accessible as a child or adult and two requiring adult Link.

evidence.quote:
There are five Gold Skullitas in the temple three of which can be collected 
as a kid or as an adult (since you can backtrack as an adult).  The  
remaining two must be collected as an adult.

subject: Zora's Fountain Secret Hole
text: Lifting the silver rock near Lord Jabu-Jabu's area with the Silver Gauntlets reveals a hole leading to invisible enemies, a ladder, and Gold Skulltula [GS091] on the left wall.

evidence.quote:
There's a  
silver rock that couldn't be bombed before lift it with the gauntlets and  
drop into the hole, after killing a series of invisible skullitas you'll  
find a ladder, climb to the top and kill one more skullita and on the wall  
to your left you'll see [GS091].

subject: Death Mountain Crater Smoking Rock
text: Riding the grown magic bean platform at Death Mountain Crater carries Link up around a smoking rock with a Piece of Heart [PoH35] on top.

evidence.quote:
Now play the Bolero of Fire and you'll  
see that the bean you had planted is now a platform that will take you up  
around one of the smoking rocks with [PoH35] on top.

subject: Desert Colossus Crater
text: Standing on the rock by the crater opposite the Spirit Temple entrance and playing the Song of Storms creates a fairy fountain.

evidence.quote:
On the opposite side of the 
Temple entrance from where you're standing you'll see a crater with a rock 
outside of the ground next to it.  Stand on the rock and play the song of 
storms to make a fairy fountain.

subject: Desert Colossus Palm Tree
text: Gold Skulltula [GS092] is found on the back of a palm tree at Desert Colossus at night.

evidence.quote:
On the back side of one of the palm trees 
(at night time) you'll see [GS092].

subject: Desert Colossus Rock
text: Riding the magic bean plant at night at Desert Colossus lets Link reach Gold Skulltula [GS093] on top of a rock.

evidence.quote:
Now head back to where you planted the 
magic beans as a kid and ride on the bean plant (be sure it's night time) 
as you pass one of the rocks you'll see [GS093] on top of it.

subject: Desert Colossus Arch Platform
text: Riding the bean platform under the upside-down U-shaped platform at Desert Colossus leads to the final Piece of Heart [PoH36].

evidence.quote:
After 
collecting the skullita head back to that bean platform and ride it one 
last time until it goes under the 'upside-down 'U' shaped platform".  On 
top you'll find [PoH36].  Congratulations you've collected all of the 
pieces of heart in the game.

subject: Spirit Temple Statue Ledge
text: Walking up the giant statue's right bicep and playing the scarecrow song summons Pierre to the ledge by the right hand to reach a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
The hardest one to get is on the right side of the huge  
statue.  To get the scarecrow to appear on the ledge by the statue's right  
hand walk up the right bicep and play the song.

subject: Shadow Temple
text: The Shadow Temple contains a total of five Gold Skulltulas.

evidence.quote:
inside this temple there are a total of five Gold Skullitas  
(imagine that, you walk in with 95 and there are 5 more inside the level).

subject: Shadow Temple Ship Screen
text: Calling the scarecrow to the platform above the dragged block's starting location and using the Longshot allows Link to reach a Gold Skulltula on the ship screen.

evidence.quote:
The most frequently missed one is on the screen with the ship, you can call 
the scarecrow to the platform above where the block you dragged across the 
room started, and longshot the scarecrow.

subject: Father of the Skulltula Family
text: After collecting all 100 Gold Skulltulas, the father of the cursed family gives Link 200 rupees each time Link talks to him upon re-entering the screen.

evidence.quote:
With all 100 Gold  
Skullitas you now have infinite rupees since the father of the skullita  
family will give you 200 rupees every time you talk to him for the first  
time in that screen

subject: Temple of Time
text: Link receives the Light Arrows at the Temple of Time.

evidence.quote: So head to the Temple of Time and you'll get the light arrows

subject: Ganon's Castle Barriers
text: The Shadow barrier must be completed before the Fire or Light barriers can be completed inside Ganon's Castle.

evidence.quote:
Make the first barrier you go through the shadow barrier,  
after that the order doesn't matter (actually you can go in any order but  
the shadow must be done before the fire or light barriers can be  
completed).

subject: Shadow Barrier Room
text: In the Shadow barrier room, killing the Like Like with an Ice Arrow and shooting the torch allows Link to cross and hit a switch that drops a chest with the Golden Gauntlets.

evidence.quote:
shoot the  
likelike with one and it'll die in one hit.  Now shoot the torch to your  
right with a rife arrow and run like there's no tomorrow...Once you hit the switch a treasure chest will  
drop which you can hookshot to and get the gold gauntlets.

subject: Ganon's Castle Fairy Fountain
text: Tossing the pillar block outside Ganon's Castle reveals a Great Fairy Fountain granting a white lining around Link's hearts that reduces all damage by half.

evidence.quote:
Once you cross the bridge new bridge  
run to your left where you see a huge pillar like block...toss it aside and 
go in where you'll find a fairy fountain and you'll receive the white  
lining around your hearts making all damage to you reduced by half.

subject: Ice Arrows
text: The only good thing about the ice arrows is that they kill likelike's in one hit.

evidence.quote:
The only good thing about the ice  
arrows is that they kill likelike's in one hit.
